m: A **square** made to **stand** up in three directions becomes a **cube**.
ex: 这个箱子大约有一立方米。
This box is about one cubic metre.
二的立方是八。
The cube of two is eight.
use: Used for cubes in maths and before units: 立方米 cubic metre.

m: **Finished** and fully **prepared**: nothing is missing, so it is **complete**.
ex: 这里的设施很完备。
The facilities here are very complete.
我们还没有一套完备的计划。
We don't yet have a complete plan.
use: Formal; often describes facilities, systems, plans or procedures.

m: To **grow** new life and **have children**: to **give birth**.
ex: 她生育了两个孩子。
She gave birth to two children.
很多年轻人推迟了生育的时间。
Many young people put off having children.
use: Formal word; in daily talk people say 生孩子.

m: A person who stands **high** and is **still** above petty things is **noble**.
ex: 他是一个品德高尚的人。
He is a man of noble character.
帮助别人是一种高尚的行为。
Helping others is a noble act.
use: Often with 品德 (character) or 情操 (sentiments).

m: **Lean over** (overturn) towards someone to **listen**: to **listen attentively**.
ex: 她总是认真倾听孩子的想法。
She always listens carefully to her child's ideas.
好老师懂得倾听学生的声音。
A good teacher knows how to listen to students.
use: More formal and caring than 听; often 倾听 + 意见 or 声音.

m: **Because of** a fixed **period of time**, it is **lasting** that long.
ex: 这次培训为期三天。
This training lasts three days.
我们参加了一个为期一周的活动。
We took part in a week-long event.
use: Followed by a length of time: 为期一个月的展览.

m: Where you **walk** inside a building: the **corridor**.
ex: 请不要在走廊里跑。
Please don't run in the corridor.
他的办公室在走廊的尽头。
His office is at the end of the corridor.
use: Measure word 条.

m: What the **head** **wants** first is **the most important**.
ex: 安全是我们的首要任务。
Safety is our top priority.
现在首要的问题是找到资金。
The most important problem now is finding money.
use: Used before nouns: 首要任务, 首要问题, 首要目标.

m: The **older brother's wife** (with the **noun suffix**): your **sister-in-law**.
ex: 我嫂子做饭特别好吃。
My sister-in-law is a great cook.
嫂子，我哥在家吗？
Sister-in-law, is my brother home?
use: Also used to politely address a friend's wife.

m: **Work** that a **husband** puts in takes **time**: 工夫 is a stretch of **time**.
ex: 一会儿工夫，他就回来了。
In no time at all, he was back.
我今天没工夫陪你逛街。
I don't have time to go shopping with you today.
use: Spoken; 没工夫 = no time. Don't confuse with 功夫 kung fu, skill.

m: **Assign** it to any **idea** you like: **any**, **arbitrary**.
ex: 你可以任意选择一个座位。
You can choose any seat you like.
不要任意改变别人的计划。
Don't change other people's plans as you please.
use: Often before verbs: 任意选择, 任意修改. Slightly formal.

m: **Initiate** something and **transmit** it to others: to **advocate**.
ex: 学校倡导绿色生活。
The school advocates green living.
政府倡导大家节约用水。
The government encourages everyone to save water.
use: Formal; used for ideas, lifestyles and campaigns.

m: The **gas** (breath) behind your **dialect** and words: your **tone**.
ex: 他说话的语气很冷。
He spoke in a cold tone.
请你换一种语气跟我说话。
Please speak to me in a different tone.
use: Also the grammar term "mood"; 语气词 are sentence particles like 吗, 吧.

m: Looking **in** a **bronze mirror** to see the facts: **in view of** them.
ex: 鉴于天气不好，比赛推迟了。
In view of the bad weather, the match was postponed.
鉴于这种情况，我们决定取消旅行。
Given this situation, we decided to cancel the trip.
use: Formal; begins a sentence giving the reason for a decision.

m: The **nature** that tells people **apart** (leave/differ): **gender**.
ex: 请在表上写你的性别。
Please write your gender on the form.
这份工作没有性别要求。
This job has no gender requirement.
use: Used on forms: 性别：男/女.

m: A **flower** that **grows** into a nut under the ground: the **peanut**.
ex: 我对花生过敏。
I'm allergic to peanuts.
他买了一包花生当零食。
He bought a bag of peanuts as a snack.
use: Measure word 粒 or 颗 for single nuts; 花生油 peanut oil.

m: A **small** fellow you share **meals** with (plus a **noun suffix**): a **young man**.
ex: 这个小伙子很能干。
This young man is very capable.
小伙子，你在找谁？
Young man, who are you looking for?
use: Spoken and friendly; used by older people to address young men.

m: So **glorious** it seems **soft** and melting with light: **brilliant**.
ex: 今天阳光灿烂。
Today the sunshine is brilliant.
她脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。
A bright smile appeared on her face.
use: Common with 阳光 (sunshine), 笑容 (smile), 文化 (culture).

m: **Store up** things so they **exist** for later: to **store**.
ex: 土豆要储存在阴凉的地方。
Potatoes should be stored in a cool place.
手机里储存了很多照片。
Lots of photos are stored on the phone.
use: Used for food, energy, data; 存 alone is more spoken.

m: **Cover** things with a **cloth**: a **bundle wrapped in cloth**; also a burden.
ex: 她背着一个大包袱上了车。
She got on the bus carrying a big bundle.
别把这件事当成思想包袱。
Don't let this weigh on your mind.
use: Figuratively a mental burden: 思想包袱, 放下包袱 (let go of a burden).

m: A **seat** in a set **position**: your **seat**.
ex: 这个座位有人吗？
Is this seat taken?
我在火车上找到了自己的座位。
I found my seat on the train.
use: Measure word 个. 座位 is a place to sit; 椅子 is the chair itself.

m: A **bamboo frame** **covers** everything: to **envelop** or **shroud**.
ex: 大雾笼罩着整个城市。
Thick fog shrouded the whole city.
房间里笼罩着悲伤的气氛。
A sad mood hung over the room.
use: Usually 笼罩着 + place; used for fog, darkness, moods.

m: **Paste** **applied** all over your thinking: **muddled**.
ex: 我真糊涂，又忘了带钥匙。
How silly of me, I forgot my keys again.
这个问题把我搞糊涂了。
This question has got me confused.
use: Spoken: 搞糊涂 = confuse; 糊里糊涂 = in a muddle.

m: **Hold** onto the **blame** and keep talking about it: to **complain**.
ex: 他总是抱怨工作太累。
He's always complaining that work is too tiring.
别抱怨了，快点做吧。
Stop complaining and get on with it.
use: Followed by what you complain about.

m: Feelings rush down a **thoroughfare** and **move** you: an **urge**, **impetuous**.
ex: 你别太冲动，先冷静一下。
Don't be rash; calm down first.
我突然有一种想哭的冲动。
I suddenly had an urge to cry.
use: As adjective often with 太 or 别; 一时冲动 = on a sudden impulse.

m: You **eat** a sudden **startle**: to be **startled**, **shocked**.
ex: 听到这个消息，大家都很吃惊。
Everyone was shocked to hear the news.
他的中文好得让我吃惊。
His Chinese is so good it amazed me.
use: Often 很吃惊, 大吃一惊 (be greatly surprised).

m: **Hinder** someone and **block their path**: to **stop** them.
ex: 他想走，我们没有阻拦。
He wanted to leave, and we didn't stop him.
门口的保安阻拦了那个人。
The guard at the door stopped that man.
use: Used for stopping people physically or from doing something.

m: **Small** things to **eat**: **snacks** and **street food**.
ex: 这条街上有很多小吃。
There are lots of snacks on this street.
我最喜欢北京的小吃。
I love Beijing's street food most.
use: 小吃 is local snack food; packaged snacks are 零食.

m: **Entrust** and **trust** something to someone: to **place** your hopes in it.
ex: 父母把希望寄托在孩子身上。
Parents place their hopes on their children.
音乐是他唯一的精神寄托。
Music is his only emotional support.
use: Usually 把希望/感情 寄托在 + someone or something.

m: **Dig** and **dig** again: to **excavate**, to **unearth**.
ex: 工人们正在挖掘一条隧道。
The workers are digging a tunnel.
我们要挖掘每个学生的潜力。
We should tap each student's potential.
use: Literal for digging; figurative with 潜力 (potential) or 人才 (talent).

m: **Opportune** and **clever** at once: **ingenious**.
ex: 这个设计非常巧妙。
This design is very ingenious.
他巧妙地回答了记者的问题。
He answered the journalist's question cleverly.
use: Describes methods and designs; with 地 before verbs.

m: A **strong** **system** makes you do it: to **force**, **compulsory**.
ex: 公司不能强制员工加班。
A company can't force staff to work overtime.
这是强制性的规定。
This is a compulsory rule.
use: Formal; 强制性 = compulsory. 强迫 is the everyday word for forcing a person.

m: **Years** of age and passing **moons**: the **years**, **time**.
ex: 岁月在她脸上留下了痕迹。
The years have left their marks on her face.
我永远不会忘记那段岁月。
I'll never forget those years.
use: Literary and emotional; for a span of life, not for counting years.

m: The **power** of being **wise**: **intelligence**.
ex: 这个游戏可以开发孩子的智力。
This game can develop children's intelligence.
他的智力很高。
He is highly intelligent.
use: Common in 智力测验 (IQ test).

m: **Pass** and **cross** through a stretch of time: to **spend** it.
ex: 我们在海边度过了一个愉快的假期。
We spent a happy holiday by the sea.
他们一起度过了很多困难。
They got through many hardships together.
use: Used for time and hard periods; 渡过 is for crossing water.

m: A **book** (root) where your **brush** **records** things: a **notebook**, or a **laptop**.
ex: 我买了一个新笔记本。
I bought a new notebook.
他用笔记本电脑工作。
He works on a laptop.
use: Measure word 本 for paper notebooks, 台 for laptops (笔记本电脑).

m: Under a **quilt**, you only **move** when pushed: **passive**.
ex: 他工作很被动，从不主动。
He's passive at work and never takes the lead.
我们现在处于被动的地位。
We're now in a passive position.
use: Opposite of 主动 (active, taking initiative).

m: The **compass** and the **square** set the measure: a **standard**, a spec.
ex: 这些零件的规格不一样。
These parts have different specifications.
这次会议的规格很高。
This meeting is very high-level.
use: Product specs; also the level or grade of an event.

m: **Compare** your **capacity** with someone's: to **compete with** them.
ex: 两个队在决赛中较量。
The two teams faced off in the final.
这是一场实力的较量。
This is a contest of strength.
use: Often 和/与 + someone + 较量; sounds serious.

m: Both sides are **right** when you **weigh** them equally: **symmetrical**.
ex: 这座建筑左右对称。
This building is symmetrical left and right.
人的脸并不是完全对称的。
A person's face isn't completely symmetrical.
use: Often 左右对称; 不对称 = asymmetrical.

m: A **candle** of wax, a **candle** that burns: a **candle**.
ex: 停电了，快去点一支蜡烛。
The power's out; quick, light a candle.
蛋糕上有十根蜡烛。
There are ten candles on the cake.
use: Measure word 根 or 支; light one with 点蜡烛.

m: **Lucky** and **auspicious** together: **lucky**.
ex: 红色在中国是吉祥的颜色。
Red is a lucky colour in China.
祝你新年吉祥如意！
Wishing you good luck in the New Year!
use: Common in greetings: 吉祥如意. 吉祥物 = mascot.

m: **Fire** and its **flame**: a **flame**, a **blaze**.
ex: 火焰越烧越高。
The flames grew higher and higher.
他看着蜡烛的火焰发呆。
He stared blankly at the candle flame.
use: More descriptive than 火; measure word 团.

m: A **pattern** of **fields** marked into groups: a **category**.
ex: 这个问题不属于法律范畴。
This issue doesn't fall into the legal category.
这已经超出了我的工作范畴。
That is beyond the scope of my job.
use: Formal; often 属于……范畴 (belongs to the scope of).

m: An **old** (familiar) and **real** person: **honest**.
ex: 他是个老实人，从不说谎。
He's an honest man and never lies.
你老实告诉我，发生了什么？
Tell me honestly, what happened?
use: Also "well-behaved": 老实点！ = behave yourself!

m: The **ten-day period** **within** the month: the **middle third of a month**.
ex: 我五月中旬去上海。
I'm going to Shanghai in mid-May.
考试安排在下个月中旬。
The exam is scheduled for the middle of next month.
use: Goes with 上旬 (first ten days) and 下旬 (last ten days).

m: A **branch of study** you keep an **eye** on: a **subject**.
ex: 你最喜欢哪个科目？
Which subject do you like best?
这次考试一共有四个科目。
This exam has four subjects in total.
use: For school or exam subjects.

m: **Neglect** it and treat it as **brief**: to **overlook**, to **ignore**.
ex: 我们不能忽略这个问题。
We can't overlook this problem.
他忽略了一个重要的细节。
He missed an important detail.
use: Often for details, problems or feelings; 忽视 is a near synonym.

m: **Empty** and **white**: a **blank space**.
ex: 请在空白处写上你的名字。
Please write your name in the blank space.
听到问题，我脑子里一片空白。
When I heard the question, my mind went blank.
use: 一片空白 = completely blank; 填补空白 = fill a gap.

m: **Take part in** **planning**: a **staff officer**, or someone who **gives advice**.
ex: 你帮我参谋一下，买哪件好？
Help me think it over: which one should I buy?
他在部队当过参谋。
He served as a staff officer in the army.
use: Spoken: 帮我参谋参谋 = give me your advice.

m: A **desire** as strong as gazing at the **full moon**: **desire**, longing.
ex: 他对金钱的欲望很强。
He has a strong desire for money.
人要学会控制自己的欲望。
People need to learn to control their desires.
use: Often 对……的欲望; can sound negative, like greed or craving.

m: **Recognize** that it **can** pass: to **approve**, **approval**.
ex: 他的能力得到了大家的认可。
His ability was recognized by everyone.
老板认可了我们的方案。
The boss approved our plan.
use: Common in 得到认可 (win approval).

m: **Break** it in the **middle**: to **cut short**, to **break off**.
ex: 比赛因为下雨中断了。
The match was interrupted by rain.
网络突然中断了。
The internet connection suddenly dropped.
use: Used for talks, signals, studies, contact.

m: A **lodge for the night** in a house you **give up** in the morning: a **dormitory**.
ex: 我住在学校的宿舍里。
I live in the school dormitory.
我们宿舍有四个人。
There are four people in our dorm room.
use: Measure word 间 for rooms; 宿舍楼 = dormitory building.

m: How the **troops** are **disposed** and what they **hold**: a **line-up**.
ex: 这部电影的演员阵容很强。
This film has a strong cast.
今晚球队派出了最强阵容。
Tonight the team fielded its strongest line-up.
use: Today mostly for casts and team line-ups.

m: **Grand** and **heavy** with ceremony: **grand**, solemn.
ex: 学校举行了隆重的毕业典礼。
The school held a grand graduation ceremony.
他们隆重地欢迎了客人。
They gave the guests a grand welcome.
use: For ceremonies and celebrations, often with 举行.

m: **Install** people somewhere **calm**: to **help settle down**, to find a place for.
ex: 政府安置了受灾的群众。
The government resettled the disaster victims.
先把行李安置好再出去吃饭。
Let's settle the luggage first, then go out to eat.
use: Mostly for resettling people; also for placing things.

m: **Cover** it and **wrap it around**: to **wrap up**; a **parcel**.
ex: 我今天收到了一个包裹。
I received a parcel today.
她用毛巾把孩子包裹起来。
She wrapped the child in a towel.
use: As a noun, a parcel in the post; measure word 个 or 件.

m: Wild as a **field** **barbarian**: **barbarous**, **uncivilized**.
ex: 打人是很野蛮的行为。
Hitting people is barbaric behaviour.
他开车太野蛮了。
He drives far too aggressively.
use: Describes rough or rude behaviour, not groups of people.

m: **Measure** someone's **capacity** with your eyes: to **size them up**.
ex: 她上下打量了我一番。
She looked me up and down.
老人仔细打量着这个陌生人。
The old man carefully sized up the stranger.
use: Often 上下打量 (look up and down). Neutral tone 量 (liang).

m: **Hand over** to the person who **substitutes** for you: to **give instructions**, or to explain.
ex: 妈妈出门前交代了几件事。
Mum gave a few instructions before going out.
你得把事情交代清楚。
You need to explain things clearly.
use: Also "confess": 交代问题. Same as 交待.

m: **Disguise yourself** and **perform**: to **play the role of**.
ex: 她在电影里扮演一位老师。
She plays a teacher in the film.
父母在孩子成长中扮演着重要角色。
Parents play an important role in a child's growth.
use: Usually 扮演 + 角色 (role); also figurative.

m: **Harness** the horse and let it **speed**: to **drive** or **pilot**.
ex: 他驾驶飞机已经二十年了。
He has been flying planes for twenty years.
酒后不能驾驶。
You must not drive after drinking.
use: Formal; 开车 is the spoken word. 驾驶员 = driver, pilot.

m: **Cover** it and **adorn** it: to **package**; **packaging**.
ex: 这个礼物的包装很漂亮。
The wrapping on this gift is beautiful.
请帮我把这本书包装一下。
Please wrap this book for me.
use: Also used for promoting a person's image.

m: A **scar** and a **trace** left behind: a **mark**, a **vestige**.
ex: 桌子上有被烧过的痕迹。
There are burn marks on the table.
小偷没有留下任何痕迹。
The thief didn't leave a single trace.
use: Often 留下痕迹 (leave a trace).

m: A **feeling** is **sent out** in your mind: you **become aware**.
ex: 我发觉他今天不太高兴。
I noticed he wasn't very happy today.
等我发觉的时候，钱包已经不见了。
By the time I noticed, my wallet was gone.
use: Close to 发现, but 发觉 stresses sensing something gradually.

m: A **restroom** is **actually** a place (所): a **toilet**.
ex: 请问，厕所在哪儿？
Excuse me, where is the toilet?
我去一下厕所。
I'm just going to the toilet.
use: Plain everyday word; 洗手间 and 卫生间 sound more polite.

m: **Burnt** with **urgent** worry: **anxious**.
ex: 她焦急地等着医生的消息。
She waited anxiously for news from the doctor.
看他那么焦急，我也很担心。
Seeing him so anxious, I got worried too.
use: Written style; 着急 is the everyday word.

m: The **tongue** at the **head** of your mouth: the **tongue**.
ex: 我不小心咬到了舌头。
I accidentally bit my tongue.
这汤太烫了，烫到我的舌头了。
This soup is too hot, it burned my tongue.
use: 头 here is a noun suffix, read neutral tone.

m: **Chase** something until you find out what it is **after all**: to **look into**.
ex: 公司要追究这件事的责任。
The company will find out who is responsible for this.
这件事就算了，我不追究了。
Let's drop it; I won't pursue the matter.
use: Usually 追究责任 (hold someone responsible).

m: A **gorge** cutting through a **valley**: a **canyon**.
ex: 这条河穿过一个很深的峡谷。
This river runs through a deep canyon.
我们在峡谷里走了一整天。
We walked in the canyon all day.
use: Measure word 个 or 条.

m: **Yellow** light when everything turns dim and **muddled**: **dusk**.
ex: 黄昏的时候，我们在河边散步。
At dusk we take a walk by the river.
太阳下山了，已经是黄昏了。
The sun has set; it's already dusk.
use: Somewhat literary; 傍晚 is the everyday word.

m: Like jade being **carved** (琢) and **rubbed**, your mind works an idea over: to **ponder**.
ex: 我琢磨了半天也没想明白。
I mulled it over for ages and still couldn't figure it out.
你琢磨一下他这句话的意思。
Think about what he meant by that.
use: Spoken. Read zuómo for "ponder"; zhuómó means polishing jade or writing.

m: **Show** your **idea** without words: to **hint**, to **indicate**.
ex: 他用手示意我坐下。
He gestured for me to sit down.
老师点头示意他继续。
The teacher nodded for him to go on.
use: Usually with a gesture: 点头示意, 用眼神示意.

m: **Sheep** **meat**: **mutton**, lamb.
ex: 冬天我喜欢吃羊肉。
I like to eat lamb in winter.
这家店的羊肉串很有名。
This shop's lamb skewers are famous.
use: 羊肉串 = lamb kebab; 涮羊肉 = Beijing lamb hotpot.

m: **Walk** goods through for **personal** gain, hiding them: to **smuggle**.
ex: 他因为走私被抓了。
He was arrested for smuggling.
走私香烟是违法的。
Smuggling cigarettes is illegal.
use: Used for goods; 走私犯 = smuggler.

m: **Make a circuit** and **turn** around again: to **circulate**, cash flow.
ex: 公司最近资金周转有困难。
The company has had cash-flow problems lately.
能借我点钱周转一下吗？
Could you lend me some money to tide me over?
use: Mostly about money: 资金周转 (cash flow).

m: It **collapses** like a dam **bursting**: to **fall apart**.
ex: 他们的婚姻已经崩溃了。
Their marriage has fallen apart.
我每天加班，快崩溃了。
I'm working overtime every day; I'm about to break down.
use: Used for systems, economies and, in speech, emotional breakdowns.

m: Hope is **cut short** like the **full moon** vanishing: to **despair**.
ex: 不要绝望，总会有办法的。
Don't despair, there's always a way.
他感到非常绝望。
He felt utterly hopeless.
use: Opposite of 希望 (hope); 对……绝望 = lose hope in.

m: **Alerted** and a little **fearful**: **vigilant**, on the alert.
ex: 我们要提高警惕。
We need to be more vigilant.
对陌生人要保持警惕。
Stay on guard with strangers.
use: Common in 提高警惕, 保持警惕.

m: A **person**'s **nature**: **human nature**, humanity.
ex: 这本书写出了人性的复杂。
This book shows the complexity of human nature.
他做的事太没有人性了。
What he did was utterly inhuman.
use: 没有人性 = inhuman; 人性化 = user-friendly, humane.

m: A **system** that **cuts** you down: to **punish**, **sanctions**.
ex: 他们受到了法律的制裁。
They were punished by law.
一些国家对它实行了经济制裁。
Some countries imposed economic sanctions on it.
use: Formal; legal punishment or international sanctions.

m: The **root** of a **play**: its **script**.
ex: 这个剧本是他写的。
He wrote this script.
演员们正在读新剧本。
The actors are reading the new script.
use: Measure word 个 or 部.

m: **Put into effect** and **spread out** your skills: to **put them to use**.
ex: 这份工作让他能施展自己的才能。
This job lets him make full use of his talents.
在这里你可以充分施展。
Here you can really show what you can do.
use: Usually with 才能, 本领 (skills, abilities).

m: **Model** in clay and **make** a shape: to **mold**, to portray.
ex: 这部小说塑造了一个英雄的形象。
This novel portrays a hero.
环境会塑造人的性格。
Environment shapes a person's character.
use: Used for characters in art and for shaping personality or image.

m: When the purse is **full** and **sharp** returns come in: **profit**.
ex: 公司今年开始盈利了。
The company started making a profit this year.
这家店的盈利不多。
This shop doesn't make much profit.
use: Business term; 赚钱 is the spoken equivalent.

m: **Invite** (call up) the money and **receive** it: to **levy** a tax.
ex: 政府对烟酒征收高税。
The government levies high taxes on tobacco and alcohol.
这块土地被政府征收了。
This land was taken over by the government.
use: Formal; with taxes, fees, or land.

m: A **boundary** that **limits** you: a **boundary**, a line.
ex: 工作和生活要有界限。
There should be a line between work and life.
他分不清玩笑和侮辱的界限。
He can't tell where a joke ends and an insult begins.
use: Often abstract; 划清界限 = draw a clear line.

m: **Examine** what is **beautiful**: **aesthetics**, taste.
ex: 每个人的审美都不一样。
Everyone's taste is different.
这个设计很符合年轻人的审美。
This design suits young people's taste.
use: 审美观 = aesthetic sense; 审美能力 = taste.

m: An **accurate** **standard**: a **norm**, a guideline.
ex: 诚实是我做人的准则。
Honesty is my principle in life.
公司有一套行为准则。
The company has a code of conduct.
use: Formal; 行为准则 = code of conduct.

m: At all **o'clock**s, **always**: **often**.
ex: 我时常想起小时候的事。
I often think about my childhood.
他时常来这家咖啡馆。
He often comes to this café.
use: A bit more written than 常常 or 经常.

m: The **marriage** **gift** of a ceremony: a **wedding**.
ex: 他们下个月举行婚礼。
They're holding their wedding next month.
我参加了朋友的婚礼。
I went to a friend's wedding.
use: Measure word 场; 举行婚礼 = hold a wedding.

m: **Attack** and **be able to** take it: to **capture**, to crack a hard problem.
ex: 科学家们攻克了这个难题。
The scientists cracked this tough problem.
我们终于攻克了技术难关。
We finally overcame the technical hurdle.
use: Now mostly figurative: 攻克难题, 攻克难关.

m: **Material** to **drink**: a **drink**, a **beverage**.
ex: 你想喝什么饮料？
What would you like to drink?
冰箱里有很多饮料。
There are lots of drinks in the fridge.
use: Usually soft drinks; measure word 瓶 (bottle) or 杯 (cup).

m: A **name**-famous place of **victory** (splendour): a **scenic spot**.
ex: 杭州有很多名胜古迹。
Hangzhou has many famous scenic and historic sites.
我们参观了几个名胜。
We visited a few famous sights.
use: Often 名胜古迹 (scenic spots and historic sites).

m: **Four** **limbs**: arms and legs.
ex: 运动可以让四肢更有力。
Exercise makes your arms and legs stronger.
他累得四肢无力。
He was so tired his arms and legs felt weak.
use: Formal or medical; 胳膊和腿 is more spoken.

m: **Language** **scattered** freely, not in verse: **prose**, essays.
ex: 我喜欢读朱自清的散文。
I like reading Zhu Ziqing's essays.
她写了一篇关于母亲的散文。
She wrote an essay about her mother.
use: Measure word 篇; a Chinese literary genre of short essays.

m: **Daytime** and **night**: **day and night**.
ex: 医院的急诊室昼夜开放。
The hospital's emergency room is open day and night.
这里的昼夜温差很大。
Here the temperature differs a lot between day and night.
use: Written style; 白天黑夜 in speech. 昼夜温差 = day-night temperature range.

m: **Disobey** and turn your **back** on it: to **go against**.
ex: 这样做违背了我的原则。
Doing this goes against my principles.
你不应该违背自己的承诺。
You shouldn't break your promises.
use: With 原则, 意愿, 承诺, 规律.

m: Your **name** and the **praise** it gets: **reputation**.
ex: 这件事影响了他的名誉。
This affected his reputation.
他很看重自己的名誉。
He values his reputation highly.
use: Also "honorary": 名誉主席 (honorary chairman).

m: A **commerce** **inn** where you buy things: a **shop**.
ex: 我家附近有一家小商店。
There's a small shop near my home.
商店晚上九点关门。
The shop closes at nine in the evening.
use: Measure word 家. 店 alone is common in speech.

m: The **tools** of a **home**: **furniture**.
ex: 我们买了一些新家具。
We bought some new furniture.
这套家具是木头做的。
This set of furniture is made of wood.
use: Measure word 件 (piece) or 套 (set).

m: The **place** and **border** you find yourself in: your **situation**.
ex: 他现在的处境很困难。
He is in a difficult situation now.
你应该理解我的处境。
You should understand my position.
use: Used for people, usually a difficult position.

m: **Leave** a **marriage**: to **divorce**.
ex: 他们去年离婚了。
They got divorced last year.
她跟丈夫离婚以后搬回了老家。
After divorcing her husband, she moved back to her hometown.
use: Separable: 离了婚. Use 跟/和 + person + 离婚, not 离婚 + person.

m: **Carve** and **model** a figure: a **statue**, sculpture.
ex: 公园里有一座很大的雕塑。
There's a big sculpture in the park.
他是一位雕塑家。
He is a sculptor.
use: Measure word 座 or 个; 雕塑家 = sculptor.

m: Use your **power** **to the greatest extent**: to **do your best**.
ex: 我会尽力帮你的。
I'll do my best to help you.
虽然没赢，但我们已经尽力了。
We didn't win, but we did our best.
use: 尽力而为 = do what one can; often 我尽力了.

m: Your own **eye** **observes** it: to **witness**.
ex: 他亲眼目睹了这场事故。
He witnessed the accident with his own eyes.
我目睹了这个城市的变化。
I've seen this city change firsthand.
use: Formal; often 亲眼目睹.

m: **Flour** (面) **wrapped** up and baked: **bread**.
ex: 我早上吃了两片面包。
I had two slices of bread this morning.
这家店的面包很新鲜。
This shop's bread is very fresh.
use: Measure word 片 (slice), 块, or 个 (a roll).

m: The **outside** **exterior surface**: someone's **appearance**.
ex: 不要只看人的外表。
Don't judge people only by appearance.
这个房子外表很旧，里面很新。
This house looks old outside but is new inside.
use: Contrasts with 内心 (inner self) or 里面.

m: **Joint** by joint, keep the **agreement** to use less: to **economize**.
ex: 我们要节约用水。
We should save water.
这样做可以节约很多时间。
Doing it this way can save a lot of time.
use: For resources and money; opposite of 浪费 (waste).

m: **Not** **cherishing** the cost: **not sparing** anything.
ex: 他不惜一切代价也要赢。
He wants to win at any cost.
父母不惜花很多钱让孩子学音乐。
The parents spared no expense on their child's music lessons.
use: Common in 不惜一切代价 (at all costs).

m: **Withdraw** and **receive** it back in: to **shrink**.
ex: 这件毛衣洗了以后收缩了。
This sweater shrank after washing.
公司正在收缩业务。
The company is scaling back its business.
use: Physical shrinking or cutting back operations.

m: A **number** written on the **forehead** of a bill: an **amount**.
ex: 这笔钱的数额不小。
This is no small sum of money.
请写清楚借款的数额。
Please write the loan amount clearly.
use: Formal; mostly for money: 数额巨大 (huge sum).

m: The **road** to **go out**: **a way out**, prospects.
ex: 我们必须找到一条出路。
We must find a way out.
学好外语是一条好出路。
Learning a foreign language well is a good path forward.
use: Measure word 条; also career prospects.

m: A **lamp** in a **bamboo frame**: a **lantern**.
ex: 春节的时候家家挂红灯笼。
Every home hangs red lanterns at Spring Festival.
孩子们提着灯笼在街上玩。
The children play in the street carrying lanterns.
use: Measure word 个 or 盏; 挂灯笼 = hang lanterns.

m: **Doubt** that makes you **ask**: a **question**.
ex: 如果有疑问，请随时问我。
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
毫无疑问，他是最好的。
Without a doubt, he's the best.
use: A doubt rather than an exam question (题); 毫无疑问 = no doubt.

m: **Extra** time outside your **line of business**: **spare-time**, amateur.
ex: 他业余时间喜欢画画。
He likes to paint in his spare time.
我只是一个业余歌手。
I'm just an amateur singer.
use: Before nouns: 业余时间, 业余爱好; opposite of 专业.

m: An **idea** drawn up like a **diagram**: an **intention**.
ex: 我不明白他的意图。
I don't understand what he's after.
他的真实意图是什么？
What is his real intention?
use: Formal, often hidden aims; 打算 is more everyday.

m: **Doubt** that **confuses** you: to feel **puzzled**.
ex: 她疑惑地看着我。
She looked at me, puzzled.
我心里还有很多疑惑。
I still have a lot of doubts.
use: Describes a puzzled feeling; with 地 before verbs.

m: **Walk** around and **look at** things: to **go sightseeing**.
ex: 我们游览了长城。
We toured the Great Wall.
欢迎大家来北京游览。
Everyone is welcome to visit Beijing.
use: Takes a place as object; 参观 is for museums, factories.

m: **Tremble** and **tremble**: to **shiver**, to **shake**.
ex: 她冷得全身颤抖。
She was shaking all over from the cold.
他的声音有点颤抖。
His voice trembled a little.
use: From cold, fear or emotion; 发抖 is a near synonym.

m: A **grandson** (with **noun suffix**): **grandson**; as a name, **Sun Tzu**.
ex: 她的孙子今年五岁。
Her grandson is five this year.
孙子是中国古代有名的军事家。
Sun Tzu was a famous military thinker of ancient China.
use: sūnzi (neutral tone) = grandson; Sūnzǐ = Sun Tzu.

m: Describe the **appearance** a thing **holds**: to **describe**.
ex: 我不知道怎么形容那种感觉。
I don't know how to describe that feeling.
这里的风景美得无法形容。
The scenery here is beautiful beyond words.
use: 形容词 = adjective; 无法形容 = indescribable.

m: A **finger** points and gives an **order**: an **instruction**, a command.
ex: 士兵们等待上级的指令。
The soldiers are waiting for orders from above.
电脑无法执行这个指令。
The computer can't execute this command.
use: Formal; for military orders and computer commands.

m: **Warm** **love**: to **love ardently**.
ex: 他热爱自己的工作。
He loves his job.
我们都热爱和平。
We all love peace.
use: For deep love of work, country, life; not for romantic love.

m: **Agree** to be **employed**: to **apply for a job**.
ex: 我去那家公司应聘了。
I applied for a job at that company.
有很多人来应聘这个职位。
Lots of people applied for this position.
use: 应聘 is the applicant's side; 招聘 is the employer's.

m: **Make into** something **simple**: to **simplify**.
ex: 我们要简化办事的流程。
We should simplify the procedures.
简化字比繁体字容易写。
Simplified characters are easier to write than traditional ones.
use: 简化字 = simplified characters.

m: The **manner** and **type** of a thing: its **style**.
ex: 这件衣服的样式很新。
This garment's style is very new.
你喜欢哪种样式的鞋？
Which style of shoes do you like?
use: For clothes, furniture and design; 款式 is a near synonym.

m: Make it **clear** and **get rid of** it: to **clear away**.
ex: 工人们正在清除路上的雪。
The workers are clearing snow from the road.
你应该清除电脑里的病毒。
You should remove the virus from your computer.
use: Formal; for rubbish, obstacles, data.

m: What you **believe** (信) and keep **in mind**: **faith**, **belief**.
ex: 他有坚定的信念。
He has firm convictions.
这个信念支持他走到了最后。
This belief carried him through to the end.
use: Abstract and serious; 坚定的信念 = firm belief.

m: **Spread out** something so it **appears**: to **reveal**, to show.
ex: 这次比赛展现了他的实力。
This competition showed his true strength.
眼前展现出一片美丽的风景。
A beautiful view opened up before our eyes.
use: Formal; similar to 展示, 表现.

m: **Pull** someone back and **save** them: to **save**, to **rescue**.
ex: 医生挽救了他的生命。
The doctor saved his life.
现在挽救还来得及。
There's still time to save the situation.
use: For lives, relationships, situations at risk.

m: A sound loan: **granule** + **send out**, shā-fā, the **sofa**.
ex: 他躺在沙发上看电视。
He's lying on the sofa watching TV.
我们买了一个新沙发。
We bought a new sofa.
use: Loanword from "sofa"; measure word 张 or 个.

m: A **precious** **bead**: a **pearl**.
ex: 她戴着一条珍珠项链。
She's wearing a pearl necklace.
我想买一杯珍珠奶茶。
I want to buy a bubble tea.
use: Measure word 颗 or 粒; 珍珠奶茶 = bubble tea.

m: Arriving **late** because of **doubt**: to **hesitate**.
ex: 他迟疑了一下，还是答应了。
He hesitated a moment, but still agreed.
她毫不迟疑地回答了问题。
She answered the question without hesitation.
use: 毫不迟疑 = without hesitating; 犹豫 is a near synonym.

m: With this **power** behind it, it will **certainly** happen: **bound to**.
ex: 这样下去势必会出问题。
If this continues, problems are bound to arise.
物价上涨势必影响生活。
Rising prices will inevitably affect daily life.
use: Formal; before a verb phrase, often with 会.

m: **Pass on** and **confer** knowledge: to **teach**, to impart.
ex: 老师把经验传授给学生。
The teacher passes his experience on to the students.
他传授给我很多做饭的技巧。
He taught me lots of cooking tricks.
use: Used for skills and knowledge; 传授给 + person.

m: **Contrary** to expectations, things are **inverted**: **instead**.
ex: 我想帮忙，他反倒生气了。
I wanted to help, but instead he got angry.
吃了药，病反倒更重了。
After taking the medicine, the illness got worse instead.
use: Spoken form of 反而; marks an unexpected result.

m: **Flour** (面) in long **strips**: **noodles**.
ex: 我中午吃了一碗面条。
I had a bowl of noodles for lunch.
妈妈做的面条特别好吃。
The noodles Mum makes are delicious.
use: Measure word 碗 (bowl); often just 面.

m: A **fist** (头 is a **head**-like suffix): a **fist**.
ex: 他气得握紧了拳头。
He clenched his fists in anger.
这是我们公司的拳头产品。
This is our company's flagship product.
use: 拳头产品 = flagship product.

m: **Slow** things down **and** bring harmony: to **ease** tension.
ex: 两国关系有所缓和。
Relations between the two countries have eased somewhat.
他开了个玩笑，缓和了气氛。
He told a joke to ease the atmosphere.
use: With 关系, 气氛, 矛盾 (tension, mood, conflict).

m: **Emit** yourself straight into **danger**: to **take risks**; adventure.
ex: 这样做太冒险了。
Doing this is too risky.
他喜欢冒险，去过很多地方。
He loves adventure and has been to many places.
use: Also adjectival with 太 or 很.

m: A **fruit** that is **real** and ripe: **fruit**; fruits of labour.
ex: 秋天，树上结满了果实。
In autumn the trees are full of fruit.
这是我们劳动的果实。
This is the fruit of our labour.
use: More formal than 水果 (fruit you eat).

m: How you **see** and **wait on** (treat) someone: to **regard**.
ex: 你怎么看待这个问题？
How do you view this issue?
他把我当亲人看待。
He treats me like family.
use: 把……当……看待 = treat someone as.

m: Each **step** done in **sudden** order: a **step**, procedure.
ex: 请按照步骤操作。
Please follow the steps.
做这道菜有三个步骤。
There are three steps to making this dish.
use: A step in a process; 步 alone is a footstep.

m: **Think** and **search** your mind: to **ponder**.
ex: 他思索了很久才回答。
He thought for a long time before answering.
这个问题值得我们思索。
This question is worth thinking about.
use: Written; 想 or 思考 are more common.

m: A **taste** that **grows** in your mouth: **flavour**; how something feels.
ex: 这道菜的滋味很好。
This dish tastes very good.
失恋的滋味真不好受。
Being dumped feels terrible.
use: Often for feelings: 心里不是滋味 = feel bad.

m: A **blind** **eye**: acting **blindly**.
ex: 不要盲目相信广告。
Don't blindly believe advertisements.
他做事有点盲目。
He does things a bit blindly.
use: Figurative only; for real blindness say 失明 or 看不见.

m: **Bear** what you **receive**: to **endure**.
ex: 我再也无法忍受这里的噪音了。
I can't stand the noise here any more.
她忍受着巨大的痛苦。
She endured great pain.
use: Often with 无法 or 不能 (can't stand).

m: **Fight over** a life to **save** it: to **rescue**, give emergency treatment.
ex: 医生正在抢救病人。
The doctors are giving the patient emergency treatment.
经过抢救，他终于醒了。
After emergency treatment, he finally came round.
use: Urgent rescue, especially medical; 抢救无效 = could not be saved.

m: A **bone** (头 is a noun suffix like **head**): a **bone**.
ex: 狗在院子里啃骨头。
The dog is gnawing a bone in the yard.
他摔断了腿上的骨头。
He broke a bone in his leg.
use: Measure word 根 or 块; 头 is neutral tone.

m: **Do** some **work** for someone else: to **work a casual job**.
ex: 他暑假在餐厅打工。
He works part-time at a restaurant in the summer holidays.
很多年轻人去大城市打工。
Many young people go to big cities to work.
use: Separable: 打过工. Often temporary, part-time or migrant work.

m: **Empty** and **fake**: **false**, phony.
ex: 这是一条虚假广告。
This is a false advertisement.
网上有很多虚假信息。
There's a lot of false information online.
use: Formal; used before nouns like 信息, 广告.

m: **Announced** (spread) **everywhere**: to be **found throughout**.
ex: 这家公司的商店遍布全国。
This company's shops are all over the country.
公园里遍布着鲜花。
The park is covered with flowers.
use: Takes a place: 遍布全国, 遍布世界.

m: **Advance** **beforehand**: **in advance**.
ex: 请预先告诉我你什么时候来。
Please tell me in advance when you're coming.
我们预先准备好了材料。
We prepared the materials beforehand.
use: Before verbs; 提前 and 事先 are close.

m: Go **up** onto the **net**: to **go online**.
ex: 我每天晚上都上网。
I go online every evening.
这里可以上网吗？
Can I get online here?
use: Separable: 上了一会儿网.

m: The **mother** of every **letter** (word): a **letter of the alphabet**.
ex: 英语有二十六个字母。
English has twenty-six letters.
请用大写字母写你的名字。
Please write your name in capital letters.
use: 大写字母 capital, 小写字母 small letter.

m: **Feeling attached** and **loving**: romantic **love**.
ex: 他们恋爱三年了。
They've been in a relationship for three years.
她正在谈恋爱。
She's seeing someone.
use: 谈恋爱 = be in a relationship; measure word 场.

m: **Distant** and **far**: **remote**.
ex: 他来自一个遥远的国家。
He comes from a faraway country.
这个梦想好像很遥远。
This dream seems very far away.
use: For distance or time; more literary than 远.

m: It **can** be **peaceful** this way: I **would rather**.
ex: 我宁可走路，也不坐他的车。
I'd rather walk than ride in his car.
宁可多花点钱，也要买好的。
Better to spend a bit more and buy a good one.
use: Pattern: 宁可 A 也不 B, or 宁可 A 也要 B.

m: **Ask** someone to **teach** you: to **ask for advice**.
ex: 我想向您请教一个问题。
I'd like to ask your advice on something.
有不懂的地方就去请教老师。
If you don't understand something, ask the teacher.
use: Polite; 向 + person + 请教.

m: **Bury** yourself and **lean over** low: to **lie in ambush**.
ex: 士兵们埋伏在山后。
The soldiers lay in ambush behind the hill.
他们中了敌人的埋伏。
They fell into the enemy's ambush.
use: 中埋伏 = fall into an ambush.

m: **Meagre** and **weak**: **weak**, frail.
ex: 我的数学基础比较薄弱。
My basic maths is fairly weak.
这是我们工作中的薄弱环节。
This is the weak link in our work.
use: For abstract weakness: 基础, 环节; not for body strength.

m: **Send out** and **raise** high: to **develop**, carry forward.
ex: 我们要发扬团队精神。
We should carry forward our team spirit.
他发扬了父亲的好传统。
He carried on his father's good traditions.
use: With 精神, 传统, 优点 (spirit, tradition, strengths).

m: **Add** more **drama**: to **intensify**.
ex: 雨后，交通堵塞加剧了。
After the rain, the traffic jams got worse.
这会加剧两国之间的矛盾。
This will worsen the conflict between the two countries.
use: For bad things: 矛盾, 污染, 竞争.

m: **Repair** until it is **full**: to **make up for**.
ex: 我想弥补我的过错。
I want to make up for my mistake.
钱无法弥补这样的损失。
Money can't make up for a loss like this.
use: With 损失, 不足, 过错 (loss, shortfall, fault).

m: A **mouth** where something is **lacking**: a **gap**, a **nick**.
ex: 碗边有一个缺口。
There's a chip on the rim of the bowl.
今年的资金缺口很大。
There's a big funding gap this year.
use: Physical gaps and shortfalls of money or staff.

m: **Respectful** to a **senior**: to **respect**.
ex: 我们都很尊敬这位老师。
We all respect this teacher.
尊敬的各位来宾，晚上好！
Distinguished guests, good evening!
use: 尊敬的 opens formal speeches and letters.

m: There is **not** anything that is **not** this: **only**, nothing but.
ex: 他说这些无非是想要钱。
He's only saying this because he wants money.
周末无非是看书、睡觉。
Weekends are nothing more than reading and sleeping.
use: Often 无非是; makes something sound simple or ordinary.

m: **Cut** the matter and **differentiate** right from wrong: a **referee**; to **judge**.
ex: 裁判吹响了哨子。
The referee blew the whistle.
他是这场比赛的裁判。
He is the referee of this match.
use: Commonest use: sports referee or judge.

m: **Public** **affairs**: **official business**.
ex: 他去北京办公务了。
He's gone to Beijing on official business.
不能用公务车办私事。
You can't use an official car for personal errands.
use: 公务员 = civil servant.

m: A **body** that **stands** up in space: **three-dimensional**.
ex: 这幅画看起来很立体。
This painting looks very three-dimensional.
我们去看立体电影吧。
Let's go and watch a 3D film.
use: 立体声 = stereo sound.

m: What you **see** after you **take apart** a matter: an **opinion**, a view.
ex: 他对这个问题有独到的见解。
He has unique insights into this issue.
每个人都可以说出自己的见解。
Everyone can give their own view.
use: More thoughtful than 意见; 独到的见解 = original insight.

m: A **canon** of **words**: a **dictionary**.
ex: 这个字我得查一下词典。
I have to look this character up in the dictionary.
我买了一本汉英词典。
I bought a Chinese–English dictionary.
use: Measure word 本; 查词典 = look up in a dictionary.

m: When things first **rise**, **at first**: **originally**.
ex: 起初我不喜欢他，后来成了好朋友。
At first I didn't like him, but later we became good friends.
起初，这里只是一个小村子。
Originally this was just a small village.
use: Usually starts the sentence; contrasts with 后来.

m: Gather the **chips** and **prepare**: to **get ready** for an event.
ex: 我们正在筹备一场音乐会。
We're organizing a concert.
婚礼筹备了半年。
The wedding took six months to prepare.
use: For events, meetings, organizations.

m: **Still** back to the **former** state: to **restore**.
ex: 警察想还原事故发生的过程。
The police want to reconstruct how the accident happened.
这家店还原了老北京的样子。
This shop recreates the look of old Beijing.
use: 还 is huán here, "give back".

m: **Urgent** and **dramatic**: **sudden**, rapid.
ex: 人口急剧增加。
The population increased rapidly.
天气急剧变化。
The weather changed suddenly.
use: Before verbs of change: 急剧上升, 急剧下降.

m: **Seep** in and **penetrate**: to **permeate**.
ex: 雨水渗透到墙里去了。
Rain seeped into the wall.
网络已经渗透到生活的各个方面。
The internet has permeated every part of life.
use: Literal and figurative; also for spies infiltrating.

m: **Accumulate** and **conceal** inside: to **hold in store**.
ex: 这座山里蕴藏着丰富的矿产。
This mountain holds rich mineral deposits.
年轻人身上蕴藏着巨大的力量。
Young people hold enormous potential.
use: Formal; often 蕴藏着.

m: A **barn** and a **warehouse**: a **storehouse**.
ex: 货物都放在仓库里。
The goods are all kept in the warehouse.
仓库里的东西太多了。
There's too much stuff in the storeroom.
use: Measure word 个 or 座.

m: The **right** **policy** to answer a problem: a **countermeasure**.
ex: 我们必须想出对策。
We must come up with a countermeasure.
面对这个问题，你有什么对策？
What's your plan for dealing with this problem?
use: 想对策 = think of a way to deal with it.

m: **Press against** the **system**: to **resist**, to **boycott**.
ex: 很多人抵制这个品牌。
Many people boycott this brand.
我们要抵制不良的风气。
We should resist bad social trends.
use: Formal; for products, influences, ideas.

m: **Bind** and **bind** again: to **tie up**, fetters.
ex: 不要被旧观念束缚。
Don't be held back by old ideas.
他想摆脱家庭的束缚。
He wants to break free from his family's constraints.
use: Mostly figurative; 摆脱束缚 = break free.

m: A **strip** of text in its own **section**: a **clause**.
ex: 签合同前要看清每个条款。
Read every clause carefully before signing a contract.
这个条款对我们不利。
This clause is unfavourable to us.
use: Measure word 项 or 条.

m: **Not** a **good** **idea** to **think** of: you feel **embarrassed**; also "sorry, excuse me".
ex: 不好意思，我来晚了。
Sorry, I'm late.
大家都看着他，他有点不好意思。
Everyone was looking at him, and he felt a bit embarrassed.
use: Very common light apology; lighter than 对不起.

m: **Complicated** and **magnificent**: a **bustling** place.
ex: 这是城里最繁华的街道。
This is the busiest street in the city.
上海是一个繁华的城市。
Shanghai is a bustling city.
use: For streets, cities, districts.

m: **Look at** things **happily**: **optimistic**.
ex: 她是一个很乐观的人。
She is a very optimistic person.
医生说情况不太乐观。
The doctor says the situation is not very hopeful.
use: Opposite of 悲观 (pessimistic).

m: A **mistaken** way to **take apart** the meaning: to **misunderstand**.
ex: 你误解我的意思了。
You've misunderstood what I meant.
我们之间有一些误解。
There's been some misunderstanding between us.
use: Near 误会; 误会 is more common in speech.

m: **Difficult** to **receive**: to **feel unwell**, to feel bad.
ex: 我头疼，很难受。
I have a headache and feel awful.
听到这个消息，她心里很难受。
She felt very upset hearing the news.
use: Physical or emotional discomfort.

m: The **completed** man can **not** be **raised** higher: **amazing**.
ex: 你真了不起！
You're amazing!
他一个人养大了三个孩子，很了不起。
He raised three children by himself, which is remarkable.
use: Spoken praise; 没什么了不起 = nothing special.

m: Take it **out** and **sell** it: to **sell out**, betray.
ex: 他出卖了自己的朋友。
He betrayed his own friend.
我绝不会出卖你。
I'd never sell you out.
use: Mostly "betray" today; for ordinary selling use 卖.

m: **Plan** and **fix** it on paper: to **draw up**, to **draft**.
ex: 我们已经拟定了一个计划。
We've already drawn up a plan.
律师正在拟定合同。
The lawyer is drafting the contract.
use: Formal; with 计划, 方案, 合同.

m: A **machine**-tight and **dense** secret: **classified**.
ex: 这是公司的机密。
This is company confidential information.
这份文件是机密的，不能外传。
This document is classified and must not be shared.
use: Stronger than 秘密; official or business secrets.

m: **Chemically made** **fat** for the soil: **chemical fertilizer**.
ex: 农民给庄稼施化肥。
The farmers put fertilizer on the crops.
用太多化肥对土地不好。
Using too much chemical fertilizer is bad for the soil.
use: 施化肥 = apply fertilizer.

m: Like a **circle** **filled** in: **satisfactory**, perfect.
ex: 会议圆满结束了。
The meeting ended successfully.
我们圆满地完成了任务。
We completed the task with complete success.
use: Common in 圆满结束, 圆满成功.

m: The **hard** **items** of a computer: **hardware**.
ex: 电脑的硬件出了问题。
The computer has a hardware problem.
这所学校的硬件条件很好。
This school has very good facilities.
use: Opposite of 软件 (software); also physical facilities.

m: A **heart** that can **bear** waiting: **patience**, **patient**.
ex: 老师对学生很有耐心。
The teacher is very patient with the students.
请耐心等一下。
Please wait patiently.
use: 有耐心 / 没耐心; 对 + someone + 有耐心.

m: **Rich** and **abundant**: **prosperous**, well-off.
ex: 这个村子现在很富裕。
This village is very prosperous now.
他们过上了富裕的生活。
They now live a comfortable, well-off life.
use: For people, families, places; also 富裕县, a place name.

m: A **frame** that **supports** the building: a **framework**.
ex: 房子的框架已经建好了。
The frame of the house has been built.
先把文章的框架写出来。
First write out the outline of the essay.
use: Literal frames and abstract structures or outlines.
